INSERT INTO runs (id, workflow_id, agent, kind, parent_run_id, fork_seq,
                               model, status, turns, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, 'running', ?8,
                     strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
                     strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
